title.original: SWE-rebench: An Automated Pipeline for Task Collection and Decontaminated Evaluation of Software Engineering Agents
title.zh: SWE-rebench：软件工程代理的任务收集和净化评估自动化管道
title.en: SWE-rebench: An Automated Pipeline for Task Collection and Decontaminated Evaluation of Software Engineering Agents

inclusion_reason.zh: SWE-rebench 的持续采集、环境构建、验证和时间版本化流水线可重复生产训练任务与去污染评测。
inclusion_reason.en: SWE-rebench's continuous collection, environment construction, verification, and temporal versioning repeatedly produce both training tasks and decontaminated evaluations.

abstract.zh: SWE-rebench 是持续从 GitHub 仓库抽取可交互软件工程任务的自动流水线，同时产出大规模 RL 数据和随时间更新的去污染评测集。
abstract.en: SWE-rebench continuously extracts interactive software-engineering tasks from GitHub, supplying both large-scale RL data and a time-refreshed evaluation set designed to reduce contamination.

problem.zh: 真实 SWE 交互数据既稀缺又昂贵，静态小型基准还会随模型训练语料扩张而过时，导致能力和污染效应难以区分。
problem.en: Real interactive SWE data is scarce and expensive, while small static benchmarks become stale as training corpora grow, confounding capability with contamination.

approach.zh: 流水线自动发现合适仓库与任务、构建执行环境和测试验证器，并持续采集新任务形成训练库及按时间切分的评测。
approach.en: The pipeline discovers suitable repositories and tasks, builds executable environments and test verifiers, and continually collects fresh items for training and time-sliced evaluation.

system_design.zh: 系统包含 GitHub 采集器、任务筛选与环境构建、可执行验证、质量门控、数据版本管理以及新鲜评测发布层。
system_design.en: The system combines GitHub ingestion, task filtering and environment construction, executable verification, quality gates, dataset versioning, and fresh benchmark releases.

key_results.zh: 该方法构建了大规模交互式 Python SWE 任务，并显示部分模型在固定 SWE-bench 上的优势可能受污染放大。
key_results.en: The method yields a large interactive Python SWE corpus and indicates that some models' apparent advantage on fixed SWE-bench evaluations may be inflated by contamination.

limitations.zh: 任务以公开 GitHub 和 Python 为主，自动测试可能遗漏语义回归；“新鲜”只能降低已知污染，不能证明训练语料中完全不存在任务。
limitations.en: Tasks emphasize public GitHub and Python, automated tests may miss semantic regressions, and freshness reduces known contamination without proving absence from training data.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
